interpretation: Keep dark-run persistence with a narrow scope as a secondary temporal structure descriptor; reject the symmetric non-dark scalar and do not convert persistence into a quality score.

surviving_descriptor.summary: Q90 longest observed dark run / requested source-step count
surviving_descriptor.units: fraction of the declared source-step window; not seconds or degrees

key_evidence.non_dark_q90: 1.0 for every coarse-fixed stone/region in both core and wide windows

decisions.candidate: coarse fixed inner dark Q90 longest-run fraction

decisions.candidate: coarse fixed centre dark Q90 longest-run fraction
